messages:
Alex: Quick scheduling ask — can we shift next week's cross‑func sync? We need a longer slot for an RFC + design review (not enough time on Monday).

Alex: Proposed agenda draft: 1) Roadmap pulse (5m) — Maria; 2) RFC deep dive: latency routing changes (30m) — Sasha; 3) Design tradeoffs + open questions (15m) — Eng leads; 4) Triage blocker roundup (10m) — Zane; 5) Decision capture & next steps (10m) — Tom.

Alex: Two time options: 
```
A) Wed 9:30 PDT / 16:30 CET
B) Thu 11:00 PDT / 18:00 CET
```
React with :one: for Wed, :two: for Thu, :x: keep Monday. If you can only attend part, note which agenda items you care about.

Sasha: :wave: preferring Wed. I need the 30m RFC slot to align with infra folks. I can take point on the RFC and will prepare a short decision checklist.

Maria: Wed works for me. I'll keep roadmap to 5m, will surface any backlog PRIO changes.

Tom: I'm tied up Wed morning — Thu 11 is better for me. If we do Wed, I can join the last 25m for decisions/rollouts.

Zane: Can we split the RFC session into two parts? First 15m for context, then 15m for ILP & benchmarks. Otherwise it feels rushed.

Sasha: Good call. I'll structure the deck: context (10), benchmarks (10), migration plan (10). That should fit if we move other items around.

Irene: Heads up — SRE triage will need 10 more minutes this week (several incidents in the queue). Can we expand triage to 20m?

Alex: We could trim roadmap to 3m and combine design tradeoffs into the RFC session to free up 10m. New proposal: RFC/deep design (35m), triage (15m), decisions (10m). Comments?

Tom: That sounds reasonable. If Thu is still needed for me I can join virtually for the decision segment.

Zane: If we go Wed and stretch RFC to 35m I can make only the benchmarks part — will be there for the middle 15.

Maria: Voting: :one: (Wed) from me. Also nominate @Tom for decision-capture owner? He has context on deployment windows.

Sasha: I nominate @Alex to own slot coordination + send pre-reads. Alex?

Alex: Happy to own coordination and send pre-reads by Tue EOD. Tom ok to own decision log?

Tom: OK I'll update the decision log during the meeting and post notes.

Irene: I'll flag the SRE blockers in the pre-read so we don't spend time describing them live.

deploy-bot: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.company/s/3GfY — Wed 9:30 PDT (option 1) / Thu 11:00 PDT (option 2). Please vote by EOD today.

Alex: Final action items: 1) Vote on poll (everyone) 2) Sasha: RFC slides and short checklist 3) Irene: SRE triage pre-read 4) Maria: 3m roadmap bullets 5) Tom: decision log template ready. I'll post final agenda and deck links once poll finishes.

Zane: Thanks — I'll add the benchmark report to the pre-read folder.

Sasha: Will also add a short diff of the routing change (TL;DR) so product can review impact quickly.

Alex: Great. If poll ends with split votes, we'll default to Wed and Tom covers decisions async if needed.

Maria: Cheers — voting now :thumbsup:

Tom: Voted. If Wed wins and I can't make first 20m, I'll review notes and join for decisions.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll send the pre-read checklist and calendar update after EOD.

Irene: Appreciate it.
